intro: Finding financial support as a minority student in Delaware can be crucial for your academic journey. This selection features 14 scholarships specifically aimed at supporting minority students, with award sizes generally ranging from $2,000 to $3,000. Each listing has its own unique requirements and deadlines, so it's important to review them closely to identify the best opportunities for you.

This could be a valuable resource for securing funding that aligns with your academic goals.
